notes: The mounts are distinct and tris are efficient, but at 40 studs the yellow_01 sun (a gold disc on a gold shield) and the green_01 oak leaf (a pale streak on a muted teal shield) cannot be read, so only the pennants carry kingdom identity. The shared head's arms and bolt are thin for a phone read, and red_01 and green_01 share the same carriage.
